article.story: BUFFALO, N.Y. -- — Mikkel Tyne scored all 20 of his points in the first half in Buffalo’s 93-47 victory against Division III's RIT on Monday. Tyne added six rebounds for the Bulls (3-3). Dylan Ducommun added 14 points while going 5 of 5 (4 for 4 from 3-point range) while they also had five rebounds and six assists. Antoine Lorick finished 5 of 7 from the field to finish with 13 points. Nigel Pierman, Jacob Works and Nolan Smith all scored seven to lead the Tigers. Tyne's effort led to a 48-16 lead at halftime. Up next: Buffalo visits Towson in its next matchup on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
